novel_features.name: Niche report
novel_features.description: Get a one-command brief for a niche: trending hashtags, their top creators, and representative videos ranked together.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining hashtags, their top creators, and representative videos that only sit together in the local SQLite store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When you need to understand a niche fast instead of clicking through five Creative Center pages.

novel_features.name: Trend velocity
novel_features.description: Measure which tracked hashtags are accelerating by diffing popularity curves across syncs.
novel_features.rationale: Requires historical popularity-curve snapshots persisted across syncs; the web UI shows only one window at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Spot rising trends before they peak, not after.

novel_features.name: Competitor sweep
novel_features.description: Summarize a competitor's top-performing content and which trending hashtags they ride.
novel_features.rationale: Requires cross-referencing the Top Ads library against stored trending hashtags in one query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When sizing up a competitor's creative strategy and trend positioning in one pass.

novel_features.name: New since last sync
novel_features.description: Show hashtags and top content that are newly trending since your last sync.
novel_features.rationale: Requires snapshot diffs over historical SQLite rows no single API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catch what changed overnight without re-reading the whole feed.

novel_features.name: Watch / alerts
novel_features.description: Track hashtags and report which crossed a popularity threshold since the last snapshot.
novel_features.rationale: Requires persisted per-hashtag popularity history plus a diff; impossible against the live UI alone.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Hands-off monitoring of the tags you care about.

novel_features.name: Related hashtags
novel_features.description: Surface similar or co-rising hashtags to one you specify, using stored industries and shared creators.
novel_features.rationale: Requires the joined hashtag+creator+industry graph that only exists locally after sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Expand a winning tag into its cluster of related tags.

novel_features.name: Viral / underserved score
novel_features.description: Rank hashtags and content by opportunity = high popularity + low publish count. Find what's rising but not yet saturated — the signal for what to create before everyone piles in.
novel_features.rationale: The opportunity score is computed from stored publishCnt + popularityCurve snapshots. No Creative Center view ranks by underserved-but-rising; you'd eyeball two columns and do mental math.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells you WHERE the white space is — the single most useful signal for deciding what to create.

novel_features.name: Trending/viral content discovery
novel_features.description: One ranked feed of trending/viral content pulled from the Top Ads library, representative videos in hashtag detail, and top creators' work — across all three in one list.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining three separate upstream surfaces (top-ads entityInfos, hashtag videoList, topCreators items) that the web UI keeps siloed. No single API call returns a unified viral feed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: See what's actually going viral in the niche — not just the tags, the content itself.

novel_features.name: Content & account decision brief
novel_features.description: Given a niche, output a concrete recommendation: which hashtags to ride, what content formats are working, where the saturation gaps are, how competitors are positioned, and what account angle is still open.
novel_features.rationale: Pure synthesis over the local store — joins viral scores, trending tags, content patterns, and competitor sweeps into one decision document. Nothing upstream produces this; it's the reason the store exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: This is the actual goal: decide what content and account to create. Every other command feeds this one.

narrative.headline: TikTok trending hashtags, viral content, and the Top Ads competitor library — synced to a local store that tells you what to create and what account to build.
narrative.value_prop: Replays TikTok Creative Center's real endpoints — trending hashtags with popularity curves and audience demographics, representative videos, and the Top Contents (Top Ads) library — and syncs them to SQLite. Then it layers on cross-entity niche briefs, growth-velocity diffing, competitor sweeps, an underserved/viral opportunity score, and a `decide` command that synthesizes all of it into a concrete content + account recommendation. The end goal isn't trends — it's the decision of what to make.
narrative.auth_narrative: Creative Center uses a login session cookie plus an X-CSRFToken header. Run `auth login --chrome` once to capture the session from your logged-in Chrome profile; the CLI replays those cookies and the CSRF token on every request. No official API key exists.

quickstart.comment: Health check with no network or auth needed
Capture your Creative Center session from Chrome
Mirror trends into the local store for offline + velocity
The whole point: what to create + what account to build

troubleshoots.fix: Session expired — re-run `auth login --chrome` and retry
Log into ads.tiktok.com in Chrome first, then `auth login --chrome`

troubleshoots.symptom: Top Ads returns 'not supported top contents setting'
troubleshoots.fix: Use default period/sort flags; omit unsupported label combinations

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for TikTok niche research (trending hashtags, their audience demographics, representative creators/videos) and competitor research (the Top Ads / top-performing content library). Ideal when an agent needs structured, offline-queryable trend data or cross-entity reports the web UI can't produce.
anti_triggers: Posting or managing TikTok ads (use the official Marketing API)
Account-level ad performance metrics for your own campaigns
